description: This file defines a custom callback handler class for the LiteLLM proxy, including several hooks for pre- and post-call processing, failure handling, moderation, and streaming within the proxy server context.

classes.name: MyCustomHandler
classes.description: A custom callback handler class extending CustomLogger to implement various async hook methods for the LiteLLM proxy, including hooks for pre-call, post-call success/failure, moderation, and streaming.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes an instance of MyCustomHandler. Currently does nothing beyond default initialization.

methods.name: async_pre_call_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, cache: DualCache, data: dict, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Asynchronous hook invoked before a proxy call, capable of modifying or inspecting the call data.

methods.name: async_post_call_failure_hook( self, request_data: dict, original_exception: Exception, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, traceback_str: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronous hook called upon failure of a proxy call, allowing logging or handling exceptions.

methods.name: async_post_call_success_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
methods.description: Asynchronous hook called after a successful proxy call, for post-processing of the response data.

methods.name: async_moderation_hook( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )
methods.description: Asynchronous hook invoked in parallel with the LLM API call for moderation purposes.

methods.name: async_post_call_streaming_hook( self, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response: str, )
methods.description: Asynchronous hook for handling streaming responses from the proxy call.

ctags.pattern: /^    async def async_moderation_hook(  # call made in parallel to llm api call$/
ctags.signature: ( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, call_type: CallTypesLiteral, )

ctags.name: async_post_call_success_hook
ctags.signature: ( self, data: dict, user_api_key_dict: UserAPIKeyAuth, response, )
